chambers.name: The Elbow
chambers.hint: A straight push is not enough: turn the stone before it reaches its seal. The bench narrows your approach.

chambers.name: The Crossbench
chambers.hint: Each stone needs its own approach. Leave room to walk around the workbench; a stone against the edge may be trapped.

chambers.name: The Three Weights
chambers.hint: Three seals must remain weighted together. The southern bench restricts your route between stones; plan where you stand after each push.

chambers.name: The Split Workshop
chambers.hint: The partition separates the upper and lower workspaces. Consider the lower weight first, then return through the opening.
